title: AI-derived cardiothoracic structures and coronary artery calcification volumes on non-contrast CT as predictors of mortality in pulmonary hypertension.
summary: AI-derived CT volumes are associated with mortality in the retrospective 620-person pulmonary-hypertension registry after clinical and REVEAL adjustment. This supports a prognostic association only; single-centre retrospective evidence does not establish causality or clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Previously validated deep-learning models derive cardiac-structure and coronary-calcium volumes from non-contrast CT; these AI-derived measures are the predictors tested.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.unknown: Regression-adjusted retrospective association analysis; single referral-centre cohort, no causal inference or demonstrated clinical benefit, and no independent validation in this cohort.
